entities.summary: Elisabeth Eidenbenz, was a teacher and a nurse and founder of the Mothers of Elne. Between 1939 and 1944, she saved some 600 children who were mostly the children of Spanish Republicans, Jewish refugees and gypsies fleeing the Nazi invasion.
